verdict.rationale: GlitchTip says it 'aims to be Sentry API compatible', and third-party tools such as GitLab and Grafana drive it through that Sentry-style API. The official CLI and built-in MCP server also give programmatic control. However, the pack contains no first-party API reference, and probes for an OpenAPI/Swagger spec all returned 404, so the API is only documented indirectly through Sentry compatibility. Missing for 10: first-party public REST API reference docs, a published OpenAPI spec, documented API authentication/tokens, independent corroboration of direct API usage.
